messages:
Maya (PM): Heads up — Acme asked for a private pilot next sprint. Need a concise handoff: owners + must-have gates.
Ken (Runtime): Must-haves from runtime: confirmed model 13B, quant profile, prewarm for chat-prefix. Can run perf delta in 48h.
Priya (Infra): Network items: VPC peering, reserved subnet for GPUs, vendor PO. Network diagram + slot request in 24h; provisioning 5-7bd after PO.
Marco (Security): KMS required. If customer allows Redwood-managed keys for pilot we save ~3d. Need SIEM forwarding + retention policy.
Liam (SRE): Observability: p95/p99, error rate, KV cache hit ratio. Will stub dashboards in 24h and add alert thresholds.
Tara (Solutions): Acme prioritizes isolation and auditable logs. They'll accept a documented hosted fallback for the canary if we get sign-off.
Maya (PM): Proposal: "Pilot-MVP" = tenant isolation + E2E encryption, p95 <1s on primary routes with 5% canary + 24h observation gate, rollback path to hosted fallback. Defer autoscale.
Ken (Runtime): Risks: quant causing regressions. Mitigation: AB eval + auto-fallback to FP16 if quality drop > threshold.
Priya (Infra): Dependency: vendor PO. If PO delayed, hosted fallback required for canary. We'll note that in deployment policy.
Marco (Security): For acceptance pack include dataflow diagram and key usage points. I'll draft audit checklist in 48h.
Liam (SRE): Recommend a short chaos check during canary (kill one worker) to validate fallback.
Maya (PM): Owners: Priya=deployment, Ken=perf signoff, Marco=security signoff, Maya=customer signoff, Liam=on-call. Everyone drop ETA by EOD so I can send timeline to Acme. :rocket:
